name: Martel Bistro & Bar
notes: From the dinner, lunch and dessert menus on the restaurant's own website. Lunch is listed as its own sections because some prices and descriptions differ from dinner. Daily specials are left out. The lunch prix fixe price is shown with the choices the site lists under it. Each side is $10; frites with truffle aioli are $7 small or $10 large. Address, phone and hours from the website.
